description: Draw tarot cards at random from a full 78-card Rider–Waite–Smith deck (cryptographically random, no repeats). Returns each card with its position, upright/reversed orientation, keywords and a link to its full meaning. Use this instead of inventing cards when a user asks for a tarot reading.

allow_reversed.description: Whether cards can come up reversed.

count.description: How many cards to draw (1–10). 1 = single card / yes-no, 3 = past-present-future.

language.description: Output language. Use "ja" when the user writes in Japanese: Japanese card / hexagram names, meanings and links to the Japanese pages. Otherwise "en".

positions.description: Optional position names in order, e.g. ["Past", "Present", "Future"].

question.description: The question being asked (echoed back only; not stored).

name: draw_tarot_cards
title: Draw tarot cards
